Hi there desk staff,
Farewell routines came up before departure, so just a quick note

I need everyone to slow down and check the handoff steps before any crate leaves the counter. Safety comes first, and rushed paperwork or loose handling can turn into a real mess fast. Please keep an eye on labels, water access, and calm loading, especially when a traveler looks stressed.

For the small dog cases, <<FACT F062>>. For bird files, <<FACT F083>>. For the larger dog bookings, <<FACT F057>>. If any detail feels off, stop and flag it right away instead of guessing. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has to protect the animal, the owner, and the crew every time.

Let's tighten this up now and keep every departure clean and safe.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
